svg.title: Jump Shuttle - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 177-178, PDF 178-179. Aligned deck envelopes preserve broad rectangular body, paired projecting forward docking clamp horns, deep stepped recess between clamps and stepped stern drive bodies. Both plans agree in beam and exterior; lower fuel-only deck not separately outlined. Illustration corroborates open front clamp form and twin aft drives. No carried ship or internal room borders included.
